initial.name: run_code
initial.description: Execute a TypeScript program against the available tools. Takes one required argument, `code`, the BODY of an async function (erasable syntax only; top-level `await` and `return` work). Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Only what you print or return is program output — curate it. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run.

code.description: The program: the body of an async TypeScript function.
